plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System - MVP Sprint

tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with core tables (users, patients, doctors, appointments, availability)
Implement backend authentication API with user registration and login endpoints (JWT-based)
Build REST API endpoints for patient registration and profile management (F1)
Create doctor availability management API and CRUD operations (F3)
Develop appointment booking API with time slot validation and conflict checking (F2)
Design and implement responsive UI components library (buttons, cards, inputs, modals) using React and TypeScript
Build patient-facing screens: Home Dashboard, Doctor Search, Appointment Booking, and My Appointments
Implement doctor dashboard with schedule view and availability management interface
Create user profile screen with edit functionality for both patients and doctors
Implement basic email notification system for appointment confirmations and reminders (F5)
Add appointment cancellation and rescheduling functionality with API and UI (F4)
Conduct end-to-end testing of core user flows and fix critical bugs
Optimize database queries and add necessary indexes for performance
Deploy MVP to staging environment and perform UAT with sample data

risks: Time slot conflict management complexity may cause booking errors if not properly validated
Email notification delivery delays or failures could impact user experience and appointment adherence
Database performance issues with concurrent booking requests during peak hours
Incomplete user authentication security could expose patient data vulnerabilities
Scope creep from stakeholders requesting additional features before MVP completion
